acceptance: Test: the new path file covers every path/pattern in auto_merge_soundness_paths.py (pinned list so the test survives the predicate's deletion)
Test: soundness-flag fails without the review section and passes with it; passes for PRs not touching soundness paths
Live proof: a throwaway PR touching a soundness path shows soundness-flag failing, then passing after the section is added; PR closed unmerged
AGENTS.md policy text updated in the same PR (G10); ledger row soundness-path hold updated
description:
Decision D4 (approved). The CODEOWNERS/code-owner-review route does NOT enforce a hold: ruleset develop-squash-only has required_approving_review_count=0, agents act as the owner, and PR #2416 touched owned paths and merged with no review decision. New mechanism:
1. Move the path list from _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py into one data file (e.g. .github/soundness-paths.txt) and a small checker.
2. ci.yml `tooling` job `soundness-flag`: when a PR diff touches a soundness path, it passes only if the PR body contains a `Soundness review:` section naming the external reviewer (codex, muse, or agy), linking the review output (PR comment), and stating all Critical/High findings resolved. Otherwise it fails with instructions.
3. Agent policy in AGENTS.md: soundness-path PRs get a dedicated external adversarial review before enqueueing.
